تستطلعوا (form X)
# تَسْتَطْلِعُوا (tastaṭliʕū) /tas.tatˤ.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# تُسْتَطْلَعُوا (tustaṭlaʕū) /tus.tatˤ.la.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
